newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech NPF bills gross 11.6 pct, oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Czech NPF bills gross 11.6 pct, oversubscribed.

text.p: A Dutch auction offering 1.2 billion crowns in 26-week Czech National Property Fund (NPF) bills was oversubscribed on Wednesday with accepted gross yield at 11.6 percent, the Czech National Bank said.
Bids totalled 2.64 billion crowns, and 80 percent of bids were accepted at 11.6 percent.
Gross yield in the last similar auction of NPF bills was 11.6 percent on January 21, and the offer of 2.5 billion crowns to the market was oversubscribed with bids totalling 5.175 billion crowns.
